g.text: IT service management — Processes and Capabilities
One system, every process that uses it and in what role, and the capabilities those processes support. This shows the business impact of changing the system. A
long list against a low criticality rating is worth a second look.

g.title: Manage application configuration and feature flags
Assess change impact of a proposed system change
Maintain the application and technology inventory
Detect and respond to security event
Maintain cardholder data scope and evidence
